style.note: Every entry carries its full style block in its prompt (style:false). Bible §6.1 blocks used verbatim: C-portrait, C-terrain, C-banner, C-ui, C-sfx, C-ambience, C-music. New classes defined by this batch (proposed for STYLE_BIBLE §6.1 by the art lead): see 'new_blocks'.

new_blocks.C-music-calm: Warm thoughtful fantasy score for planning a campaign: gentle harp and plucked strings, soft woodwind melody, light hand percussion, warm low strings, hopeful and curious, tempo around 90 bpm, instrumental.
new_blocks.C-music-sombre: Sombre fantasy score: slow low brass and cello, a lone horn melody, soft timpani, dignified and regretful, instrumental.
new_blocks.C-ambience-battle: Open battlefield bed for a fantasy war: steady wind over open ground, banners and cloth flapping, the distant rumble of marching armies and faint far-off clashing steel, even level from start to end, seamless loop.
new_blocks.C-keyart-diorama: Painted stylised 3D diorama key art of bright high fantasy: chunky simplified 3D forms with clean dark outlines, flat saturated colours with soft hard-edged shading, bright sunlit sky with soft white clouds, colourful and characterful, cinematic wide vista seen from a high three-quarter angle, open sky in the upper middle, wordless pure pictorial image.
new_blocks.C-concept: Cel-shaded character concept art of bright high fantasy: one full figure shown whole from head to feet in a front three-quarter view, standing upright in a neutral relaxed stance with the arms held slightly away from the body, thick clean dark outline, flat saturated colours with one hard shadow tone and one highlight tone, simple bold shapes, even flat lighting, single subject centred with wide empty margin on every side, plain flat light grey background.
new_blocks.C-concept-beast: Cel-shaded creature concept art of bright high fantasy: one whole animal shown from nose to tail in a front three-quarter view, standing still on all four legs with its back level and its head forward, thick clean dark outline, flat saturated colours with one hard shadow tone and one highlight tone, simple bold shapes, even flat lighting, single subject centred with wide empty margin on every side, plain flat light grey background.
new_blocks.C-structure: Cel-shaded building concept art of bright high fantasy: one whole structure shown complete on a small patch of ground in a high three-quarter view, thick clean dark outline, flat saturated colours with one hard shadow tone and one highlight tone, simple bold readable shapes, even flat lighting, single structure centred with wide empty margin on every side, plain flat light grey background.
new_blocks.C-vignette: Cel-shaded landscape vignette of bright high fantasy: a small self-contained scene seen from a gentle high angle, thick clean dark outlines, flat saturated colours with one hard shadow tone and one highlight tone, simple bold shapes, bright sunlit daylight with soft clouds, edges fading softly into a plain pale parchment border, wordless pure pictorial image.

driver: ludo.py's call()/sniff() transport with batch bodies, asc_mvp_* request ids (bumped _vN on failure), n=3 on images, one job in flight per endpoint (file locks), a balance-delta budget guard (cap 1800), per-call ledger studio/ledgers/asc-mvp-batch.jsonl
skipped: group 3 (M3 2D battle sprite sheets, effects, horizon bands, fort): cancelled by the director on 2026-10-04 before any call (the game is going 3D)
